rule_findings.title: Successful login at unusual hour
rule_findings.description: carol logged in from 10.0.7.77 at 03:14. Review indicator, not proof of compromise.

rule_findings.title: Suspicious login linked to large download
rule_findings.description: Suspicious login by carol from 10.0.7.77 followed by a 52,428,800-byte download within 1 hour. Correlation alone does not prove exfiltration.

summary: The system experienced a suspicious login attempt by carol from 10.0.7.77 at 03:14, followed by a large HTTP response of 52,428,800 bytes to /exports/customers_full.csv. The login and download were correlated, but no proof of exfiltration is provided.

attack_chain.explanation: The successful login by carol from 10.0.7.77 is the first step in the attack chain.
The large HTTP response to /exports/customers_full.csv is the second step in the attack chain.
The login and download were correlated, indicating potential exfiltration.

mitigations: Implement rate limiting on SSH login attempts to detect and block unusual login patterns.
Configure access controls to restrict access to /exports/customers_full.csv.
Implement network segmentation to limit the scope of data exfiltration.
Monitor for unusual login times and correlate with large data transfers.
Review and update SSH configuration to enforce strong password policies and disable password authentication.
